name: New River Gorge National Park
title: Holidays in New River Gorge National Park
intro: A deep, forested gorge in West Virginia, famous for whitewater rafting, rock climbing and a giant steel bridge you can walk underneath. Here's what New River Gorge National Park is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The New River Gorge Bridge spanning a forested valley in West Virginia
facts_note: There's no entry fee to visit the park. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May to October is the season, when the rafting companies run trips and the climbing and trails are at their best. Summer is warm, with gentler water for families on the upper river. October brings autumn colour and Bridge Day, on the third Saturday, when the bridge closes to traffic and BASE jumpers leap off it. Winter is cold and quiet.

things.name: New River Gorge Bridge
things.blurb: One of the longest single-span arch bridges in the world, seen from viewpoints at the Canyon Rim visitor centre.

things.name: Bridge Walk
things.blurb: A guided walk along a catwalk underneath the bridge, almost 270m above the river. Ages ten and up.

things.name: Whitewater rafting
things.blurb: The lower river has big rapids for teenagers, and the upper river has gentler trips for younger children.

things.name: Grandview
things.blurb: A clifftop viewpoint over a huge bend in the river, lovely at sunset.

things.name: Thurmond
things.blurb: An old railroad ghost town on the riverbank, with trains still passing through.

things.name: Endless Wall Trail
things.blurb: A walk through rhododendron forest to cliff-edge views, popular with climbers.

faqs.question: Is New River Gorge good for a family holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for active families. Rafting, zip lines and climbing suit older children, and there are easy viewpoints and trails for younger ones.

faqs.question: How many nights do you need?
faqs.answer: Two or three nights in Fayetteville covers rafting, the bridge and a few walks.

faqs.question: How do you get there?
faqs.answer: Fly to Charleston, West Virginia, about an hour away. Washington, D.C. is about five hours' drive.

faqs.question: Do UK families need a visa?
faqs.answer: Most British passport holders, children included, apply for an ESTA online before they fly rather than a visa. Check GOV.UK for the current rules.

faqs.question: How old do you have to be to go rafting?
faqs.answer: It depends on the trip. Gentle upper river trips often take children from around six, and the big lower river rapids usually need them to be 12 or older.
